note: Mechanical resolution of every LNA stage-1 netlist element to a PDK primitive, or to the absence of one. A measurement, not a design proposal: it selects no device flavour and proposes no geometry. See README.md for what this means for T1 items 2/3/11.

pcell_availability.consequence: `klt gen --list-pdk-pcells` reports both sg13g2 PCell libraries as unavailable for missing_dependency 'cni'. The shim directory exists but is empty -- an uninitialized submodule in this PDK install -- so no PDK-parametrized device can be instanced, and a generator is limited to the fixed-geometry cells in libs.ref/sg13g2_pr/gds/sg13g2_pr.gds plus hand-drawn or `klt gen`-drawn geometry.

elements.ratified_evidence: spec/decision-records/0001-band-selection-ka-vs-ku.md records openEMS extraction of the PDK's inductor2 PCell: the single-turn p1 geometry is 98.5 pH, and the multi-turn geometries self-resonate below the ratified band ('Multi-turn spirals are dead at Ka band'). Cited, not re-derived here.

drawn_realization.how: the pinned PDK's primitive stream ships only the fixed-geometry Nx=1 npn13G2 cell. The PDK's own parametrized npn13G2 PCell, which draws a multi-emitter device, is not instantiable in this environment (see pcell_availability below), so Nx>1 can only be approximated by Nx parallel unit cells -- a different structure, with different base resistance and emitter interconnect parasitics from the designed device
